special_handling.NumberOfLanes: categorical despite integer storage; retain 0 because it is observed mainly with Off road
special_handling.advisorySpeed: structurally sparse; do not apply ordinary mean imputation
special_handling.temporarySpeedLimit: structurally sparse; do not apply ordinary mean imputation

excluded_years.2020-2021: official CAS open-data warning says these years are incomplete
excluded_years.pre-2020: two included fields changed recording on 2019-12-17

comparison_rule: Train and evaluate CAS separately from STATS19. Compare only the direction of random-versus-temporal gaps, model-gain contraction, ordinal error patterns, and explanation-rank stability. Do not pool records or compare absolute metric levels as if labels were identical.

feature_alignment.rule: Use dataset-specific feature configurations. The feature sets are not one-to-one aligned, so CAS is an independent workflow replication, not an external test set for a model trained on STATS19.

official_definition_evidence.fatal: injury resulting in death within 30 days of the crash
official_definition_evidence.minor: minor injury such as sprain or bruise
official_definition_evidence.serious: fracture, concussion, internal injury, crushing, severe cut or laceration, severe general shock requiring treatment, or removal to and detention in hospital

prediction_time: at collision; no casualty count, participant count, struck-object, event-trajectory, response, exact-location, or outcome-derived input

raw_snapshot.csv_read_rule: pd.read_csv(..., keep_default_na=False); convert only empty strings to missing
raw_snapshot.literal_category_warning: Do not let pandas default NA parsing convert the literal source value None to NaN
raw_snapshot.where_clause: crashYear BETWEEN 2022 AND 2025 AND crashSeverity <> 'Non-Injury Crash'
